text_blocks.snippet: Losartan can cause mild side effects like dizziness and fatigue, as well as rare, serious issues like high potassium levels.
Most mild side effects improve as your body adjusts to the medicine.

list.snippet: Dizziness or lightheadedness from lower blood pressure
Upper respiratory infections or a stuffy nose
Nausea, diarrhea, or mild stomach upset

text_blocks.snippet: Some side effects require prompt medical evaluation.

list.snippet: High potassium levels (hyperkalemia): Can cause muscle weakness or an irregular heartbeat, though it often has no symptoms.
Kidney function changes: Can lead to swelling in your hands, ankles, or feet, or changes in urination.
Low blood pressure (hypotension): Can cause severe dizziness, fainting, or blurred vision.

text_blocks.snippet: Get emergency help right away if you experience:

list.snippet: Angioedema: Dangerous swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, or trouble breathing.
Chest pain or a fast, irregular heartbeat

text_blocks.snippet: If you are taking losartan, tell me:

list.snippet: Are you experiencing any specific symptoms right now?
Are you taking any other medications or supplements (like potassium)?

text_blocks.snippet: I can help you understand what might be causing your reaction or when to call your doctor.
